summary: The Iceberg community is actively discussing various integration efforts and enhancements, including the release of Apache Iceberg C++ 0.3.0 and the management of Flink version support post-Iceberg 1.11.0. Additionally, there are ongoing discussions about documentation updates and the introduction of new features in the REST spec.
highlights: Integration efforts in Iceberg Spark Community Sync
Release discussion for Apache Iceberg C++ 0.3.0
Managing Flink version support after Iceberg 1.11.0
Proposal for X-Iceberg-Client-Capabilities header in REST spec
